```{r}
plot_lmer_interaction <- function(model, x_var, color_var, y_var, save_path = NULL, width = 8, height = 6) {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(effects)
  
  pred_data <- as.data.frame(Effect(c(color_var, x_var), model))
  
  p <- ggplot(pred_data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = "fit", color = color_var, group = color_var)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_ribbon(aes_string(ymin = "lower", ymax = "upper", fill = color_var), alpha = 0.2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = color_var, fill = color_var) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to extract and print model comparison results
print_model_comparison <- function(models) {
  # Create comparison matrix
  comparison_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(models), ncol=length(models), 
                               dimnames=list(names(models), names(models)))
  
  # Compare each pair of models
  for(i in 1:(length(models)-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):length(models)) {
      comparison <- anova(models[[i]], models[[j]])
      comparison_matrix[i,j] <- comparison$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    }
  }
  
  # Print results
  cat("Model Comparison p-values:\n")
  print(round(comparison_matrix, 4))
}

  # Simpler cross-validation function
  cv_lmer <- function(formula, data, k=5) {
      set.seed(123)
      folds <- createFolds(1:nrow(data), k=k)
      mse <- numeric(k)
      
      for(i in 1:k) {
          train <- data[-folds[[i]], ]
          test <- data[folds[[i]], ]
          fit <- lmer(formula, data=train)
          pred <- predict(fit, newdata=test, allow.new.levels=TRUE)
          mse[i] <- mean((test[[varush]] - pred)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      return(mean(mse))
  }
  
  # Calculate BF using BIC differences
  BF <- function(bic1, bic2) {
      exp((bic1 - bic2)/2)
  }
```

```{r}
    form_trial <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ trial_pos + (1|sub)"))

    form_int_plusHz <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ sov * trial_pos + hz + (1|sub)"))

    cat("\n_______bayesfactor Comparisons:_______\n")

    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m0,m_trial)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_sov,m_trial)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_sov,m_int)))
    cat("\n\n")

    cat("\n==============================\n==============================\n")

    cat(sprintf("CV MSE - Hz-specific: %.2f\n", cv_m4))
    
    cat("\n============================================================\n")
    
    
    # Add diagnostic information
    cat("\nData summary before analysis:\n")
    print(table(data_table_filtered$sov))
    
    cat("\n\nAnalyzing Hz and trial_pos interaction within each sleep stage:\n")
    for(sov_level in levels(data_table_filtered$sov)) {
      sov_data <- subset(data_table_filtered, sov == sov_level)
      
      # Print diagnostics for each sleep stage
      cat(sprintf("\nSleep stage: %s, Number of observations: %d\n", 
          sov_level, nrow(sov_data)))
      
      if(nrow(sov_data) == 0) {
        cat("Skipping analysis - no data for this sleep stage\n")
        next
      }
      
      # Models with logical progression
      m0_hz <- lmer(form_0, data=sov_data)
      m1_hz <- lmer(form_trial, data=sov_data)
      m2_hz <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ hz * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      
      cat("ANOVA comparison:\n")
      print(anova(m0_hz, m1_hz, m2_hz))

      # Calculate BFs using BIC approximation
      bf10 <- BF(BIC(m1_hz), BIC(m0_hz))  # m1 vs m0
      bf21 <- BF(BIC(m2_hz), BIC(m1_hz))  # m2 vs m1
      cat("\nBayes Factors (how much Favors simpler model ):\n")
      cat(sprintf("BF10 (trial_pos effect): %.2e\n", bf10))
      cat(sprintf("BF21 (hz interaction effect): %.2e\n", bf21))
      
      # # If interaction is significant, analyze each Hz separately
      # if(anova(m1_hz, m2_hz)$"Pr(>Chisq)"[2] < 0.05) {
      #   cat("\nSignificant interaction found. Analyzing each Hz separately:\n")
      #   for(hz_level in levels(sov_data$hz)) {
      #     if(hz_level == "500") next
      #     
      #     hz_specific_data <- subset(sov_data, hz == hz_level)
      #     
      #     # Model for trial_pos effect within this Hz
      #     m_trial <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=hz_specific_data)
      #     m_null <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ (1|sub)")), data=hz_specific_data)
      #     
      #     cat(sprintf("\nHz level: %s\n", hz_level))
      #     print(anova(m_null, m_trial))
      #   }
      # }
    }
    cat("\n============================================================\n")
    cat("\nAnalyzing Hz scaling effects within each sleep stage:\n")
  
    for(sov_level in levels(data_table_filtered$sov)) {
      sov_data <- subset(data_table_filtered, sov == sov_level)
      hz_values <- as.numeric(as.character(sov_data$hz))
      harmonic_order <- c(4079, 2413, 5302, 3137, 1428, 1856, 1098, 845, 650)
      hz_harmonic <- factor(sov_data$hz)
      hz_harmonic <- factor(hz_harmonic,  levels = as.character(harmonic_order), ordered = TRUE)
      sov_data$hz_harmonic <- hz_harmonic
      sov_data$hz_Diff500 <- abs(hz_values - 500)
      hz_harmonyDiff <- match(hz_values, harmonic_order)
      sov_data$hz_harmonyDiff <- hz_harmonyDiff

      # Fit models
      m0 <- lmer(form_trial, data=sov_data)
      m_linear <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ hz_values * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      m_quad <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ poly(hz_values, 2) * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      # m_cubic <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ poly(hz_values, 3) * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      m_harmonicDiff <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ hz_harmonyDiff * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      m_nominal <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ hz * trial_pos + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)
      m_interaction <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~  trial_pos +   (hz_Diff500 * hz_harmonyDiff) + (1|sub)")), data=sov_data)

      models <- list(
      "Null Model (m0)" = m0,
      "Linear Model" = m_linear,
      "Quadratic Model" = m_quad,
      # "Cubic Model" = m_cubic,
      "Harmonic Difference Model" = m_harmonicDiff,
      "Nominal Model" = m_nominal,
      "Interaction Model" = m_interaction
    )
      cat(sprintf("\n\nSleep stage: %s\n", sov_level))

      # Create a model comparison dataframe
      model_comparison <- data.frame(
        Model = names(models),
        AIC = sapply(models, AIC),
        BIC = sapply(models, BIC)
      )
      
      # Print the full comparison table with AIC and BIC values using cat
      cat("\nModel Comparison - AIC and BIC values:\n")
      cat("Model                       AIC       BIC\n")
      cat("----------------------------------------\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(model_comparison)) {
        cat(sprintf("%-25s %-9.2f %-9.2f\n", 
                   model_comparison$Model[i], 
                   model_comparison$AIC[i], 
                   model_comparison$BIC[i]))
      }

      # Sort by AIC and BIC
      model_comparison_aic <- model_comparison[order(model_comparison$AIC), ]
      model_comparison_bic <- model_comparison[order(model_comparison$BIC), ]

      # # Print model comparison tables
      # cat("\nModel Comparison by AIC & BIC:\n")
      # print(xtable(model_comparison_aic), include.rownames = FALSE)

      # Identify best models
      best_aic <- model_comparison_aic$Model[1]
      best_bic <- model_comparison_bic$Model[1]
      cat(sprintf("\nBest Model by AIC: %s\n", best_aic))
      cat(sprintf("Best Model by BIC: %s\n", best_bic))
      
      # Identify second best models
      sec_best_aic <- model_comparison_aic$Model[2]
      sec_best_bic <- model_comparison_bic$Model[2]
      cat(sprintf("\n2nd Best Model by AIC: %s\n", sec_best_aic))
      cat(sprintf("2nd Best Model by BIC: %s\n", sec_best_bic))

    }
    
            
    # Stop redirecting output to the file
    sink()
  }
}
```

```{r}

### all on all analysis

# Define the components and variables
input_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\comp_withincond_THz"
components <- c("N100","P2", "N350")
variables <- c("comp_amp", "latency")
output_prefix <- "res_lmm_Bl0_"


for (component in components) {
  data_table <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "\\Bl0_", component, "_dataToR.csv"))  
  # Convert variables to factors:
  data_table$sov <- factor(data_table$sov, levels = c('wn','N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'REM'), ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$sub <- factor(data_table$sub, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$hz <- factor(sub("T(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", data_table$cond))
  data_table$trial_pos <- factor(substr(data_table$cond, nchar(data_table$cond), nchar(data_table$cond)))
  data_table$is_peak <- factor(data_table$is_peak, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = FALSE) 
  data_table$comp_amp <- as.numeric(data_table$comp_amp) 
  data_table$latency <- as.numeric(data_table$latency) 
  
  for (varush in variables) {
    output_file_name <- paste0(output_prefix, component, "_", varush, "_results.txt")
    # Redirect output to the file
    sink(output_file_name)
    
    initial_rows <- nrow(data_table)
    initial_subs <- unique(data_table$sub)
  
    # Track outlier removals
    std_to_remove_outliers <- 3
    outlier_filtered <- data_table %>%
      group_by(sov) %>%
      mutate(mean_varush = mean(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE),
             sd_varush = sd(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      filter(abs(.data[[varush]] - mean_varush) <= std_to_remove_outliers * sd_varush) %>%
      ungroup()
  
    outliers_removed <- initial_rows - nrow(outlier_filtered)
    outlier_removed_rows <- anti_join(data_table, outlier_filtered)
    outlier_removed_subs <- unique(outlier_removed_rows$sub)
  
    # Track peak removals
    peak_filtered <- outlier_filtered[outlier_filtered$is_peak == 1, ]
    peaks_removed <- nrow(outlier_filtered) - nrow(peak_filtered)
    peak_removed_rows <- anti_join(outlier_filtered, peak_filtered)
    peak_removed_subs <- unique(peak_removed_rows$sub)
  
    cat(sprintf("\nRows removed:\n- %d outliers (>%d SD) from %d subjects: %s\n- %d non-peaks from %d subjects: %s\n",
        outliers_removed,
        std_to_remove_outliers,
        length(outlier_removed_subs),
        paste(outlier_removed_subs, collapse=", "),
        peaks_removed,
        length(peak_removed_subs),
        paste(peak_removed_subs, collapse=", ")))
  
    data_table <- peak_filtered
        
   generate_model_formula <- function(formula) {
      as.formula(paste(varush, formula))
    }

    
    # Fit the linear mixed-effects models
    models <- list(
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz + trial_pos  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov * trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + hz * trial_pos  + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov + hz + trial_pos + (1 | sub)"), data = data_table),
      lmer(generate_model_formula("~ -1 + sov * hz * trial_pos * (1 | sub)"), data = data_table)
    )
    
    bayes_results <- bayesfactor_models(models)
    
    # Print baseline comparison results
    print("Model Comparison Results against baseline:")
    baseline_comparisons <- lapply(2:length(models), function(i) {
        comp <- anova(models[[1]], models[[i]])
        p_val <- comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]  # Get p-value for comparison
        return(p_val)
    })
    cat("\nData: data_table")
    cat("\nBaseline Model: comp_amp ~ -1 + (1 | sub)\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("%-45s %8s %12s %12s %12s %12s %12s %s\n",
       "Model", "Df diff", "Chisq", "P-value", "AIC", "BIC", "BF", ""))
    cat(paste(rep("-", 135), collapse=""), "\n")
    # Print each comparison
    for(i in 2:length(models)) {
       comp <- anova(models[[1]], models[[i]])
       stars <- ifelse(comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.001, "***",
               ifelse(comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.01, "**",
                   ifelse(comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.05, "*", "")))
       
       cat(sprintf("%-45s %8d %12.3f %12s %12.1f %12.1f %12.2e %s\n",
           bayes_results$Model[i],
           comp$Df[2],
           comp$Chisq[2],
           format.pval(comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], digits = 3),
           AIC(models[[i]]),
           BIC(models[[i]]),
           exp(bayes_results$log_BF[i]),
           stars))
    }
    
    cat("\n---")
    cat("\nSignif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1")
    cat("\nBF: Bayes Factor against baseline model")
    
    # Create summary dataframe
    model_info <- data.frame(
        Model = bayes_results$Model,
        P_value = c(NA, unlist(baseline_comparisons)),  # NA for baseline, p-values for others
        BF = exp(bayes_results$log_BF),
        AIC = sapply(models, AIC),
        BIC = sapply(models, BIC)
    )

    # Create significant_models with added criteria
    significant_models <- subset(model_info, P_value < 0.05 & BF > 3)
    significant_models$Highest_BF <- significant_models$BF == max(significant_models$BF)
    significant_models$Lowest_AIC <- significant_models$AIC == min(significant_models$AIC)
    significant_models$Lowest_BIC <- significant_models$BIC == min(significant_models$BIC)
    
    # Format for printing
    significant_models$P_value <- format.pval(significant_models$P_value, digits = 3)
    significant_models$BF <- format(significant_models$BF, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
    significant_models$AIC <- round(significant_models$AIC, 1)
    significant_models$BIC <- round(significant_models$BIC, 1)
  
    # Print summary
    cat("\nSignificant Models (p < 0.05 vs baseline and BF > 3):\n")
    cat("\nModel                                   P-value    BF        AIC     BIC     Best_BF  Best_AIC  Best_BIC\n")
    cat("------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
    for(i in 1:nrow(significant_models)) {
        cat(sprintf("%-40s %-10s %-10s %-8.1f %-8.1f %-9s %-9s %-9s\n",
            significant_models$Model[i],
            significant_models$P_value[i],
            significant_models$BF[i],
            significant_models$AIC[i],
            significant_models$BIC[i],
            ifelse(significant_models$Highest_BF[i], "*", ""),
            ifelse(significant_models$Lowest_AIC[i], "*", ""),
            ifelse(significant_models$Lowest_BIC[i], "*", "")))
    }
        
    # Get the winning model and its summary
    # Use the BF values directly from bayes_results
    bf_values <- exp(bayes_results$log_BF)
    best_model_idx <- which.max(bf_values)
    best_model <- models[[best_model_idx]]
    model_summary <- summary(best_model)
    
    cat("\nBest Model Analysis:\n")
    cat("-------------------\n")
    print(summary(best_model))
    cat("\nFixed Effects:\n")
    print(fixef(best_model))
    cat("\nConfidence Intervals:\n")
    print(confint(best_model))
    ci <- confint(best_model)
    
    
    fixed_effects <- data.frame(
      coef(summary(best_model)),
      ci = ci[rownames(coef(summary(best_model))),]
    )
    names(fixed_effects) <- c("Estimate", "Std.Error", "t.value", "CI_lower", "CI_upper")
    important_effects <- fixed_effects[abs(fixed_effects$t.value) > 2, ]
    
    cat("\nImportant Effects in Best Model:\n")
    cat("------------------------------\n")
    for(row in rownames(important_effects)) {
      cat(sprintf("%-15s: Effect = %.3f (CI: %.3f to %.3f), t = %.2f\n",
              row,
              important_effects[row, "Estimate"],
              important_effects[row, "CI_lower"],
              important_effects[row, "CI_upper"],
              important_effects[row, "t.value"]))
    }

    # Stop redirecting output to the file
    sink()
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Choose the variable to plot (amplitude or latency)
varush <- "comp_amp"  # Replace with "comp_amp" to plot amplitude instead

# Fit the final model with interaction
final_model <- lmer(as.formula(paste(varush, "~ sov * cond + (1 | sub)")), data = data_table)

# Get estimated marginal means for the interaction of sov and cond
emm <- emmeans(final_model, ~ sov * cond)

# Convert emmeans results to a data frame for plotting
emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

# Plotting interaction plot for sov and cond with estimated marginal means
ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = cond, y = emmean, fill = sov)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE), 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Interaction of Sleep Stage (sov) and Tone Repetition (cond) on", varush),
    x = "Tone Repetition (cond)",
    y = paste("Estimated Marginal Mean of", varush),
    fill = "Sleep Stage (sov)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save the plot as an image file if needed
ggsave(filename = paste("interaction_plot_", varush, ".png", sep = ""), width = 8, height = 6)


```

```{r}
# # Yoels Example:::::
# Compare the models using AIC
anova(row_glmmTMB, num_glmmTMB, row_num_glmmTMB,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB)


# Calculate Bayes factors for the models
library(bayestestR)
bayes_out_glmmTMB <- bayesfactor_models(row_glmmTMB, num_glmmTMB, row_num_glmmTMB,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB, denominator = 4)

# Print the inverse Bayes factor values for easier interpretation
print(1 / as.numeric(bayes_out_glmmTMB))

# Model Fitting Using glmmTMB with Gaussian Distribution------------

# Model 1: Random effect of SBJ_idx only
baseline_sbj_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ 1 + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                                    data = filtered_df, 
                                    family = gaussian)

# Model 2: Fixed effect of Row_Number (bin) and random effect of SBJ_idx
row_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ Row_Number + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                           data = filtered_df, 
                           family = gaussian)

# Model 3: Fixed effect of Row_Number (bin) and Number of items and random effect of SBJ_idx
row_num_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ Row_Number + num_presses + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                               data = filtered_df, 
                               family = gaussian)

# Model 4: Fixed effect of Number of items and random effect of SBJ_idx
num_glmmTMB_nor <- glmmTMB(var_convex_hull ~ num_presses + (1 | SBJ_idx), 
                           data = filtered_df, 
                           family = gaussian)

# Extract the Gauusain power parameter - sanity check should be zero for gaussian
power_param <- family_params(num_glmmTMB_nor)
print(power_param)

# Compare the models using AIC
anova(row_glmmTMB_nor, num_glmmTMB_nor, row_num_glmmTMB_nor,baseline_sbj_glmmTMB_nor)
```
